€1P. (रोहति, रुरोह, अरुक्षत्, रोक्ष्यति, रोढुम्, रूढ) 
__1 To grow, spring up, shoot forth, germinate; रूढरागप्रवालः [[

.]] 
__2 To grow up, be developed, increase; रूढं क्षुधार्दिताः वत्साः … चरन्तु … तृणम् [[

.]] 
__3 To rise, mount upwards, ascend. 
__4 To grow over, heal up (as a wound); रोहते सायकैर्विद्धं न सं रोहति वाक्क्षतम् [[

.]] 
__5 To reach to, attain. -Caus. (रोपयति-ते, रोहयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to grow, plant, put in the ground; तारयेद् वृक्षरोपी च तस्माद् वृक्षांश्च रोपयेत् [[

.]] 
__2 To raise up, elevate. 
__3 To entrust, devolve upon, commit to the care of; गुणवत्सुतरोपितश्रियः [[

.]] 
__4 To fix upon, direct towards, cast at; [[

.]] 
__5 To fix, fasten. -Desid. (रुरुक्षति) To wish to grow &c.

रुह्,
रुह a. (At the end of comp.) Growing or produced in; as महीरुह्, पङ्केरुह &c.
